notes.title: New update!
notes.content:
Hi players,

The playing field is now 40% bigger. You can take the battle outside if you want. 
As you requested there are many game breaking bug fixes. I also added some upgrade goodies in this release. These upgrade magazines give you a health boost or can give you a 25% performance upgrade on the auto turrets. 

You can also find health packs which you can use when you are low on health. Just press H to use. (d-pad down for gamepads). 

I hope you'll enjoy it. Happy holidays!
